ref_speedup_note: Anchor 1.25313 calibrated in oracle mode on the authoring CPU lane (Intel Sapphire Rapids). tests/ref_speedup.txt is authoritative at scoring; this file is only the in-image fallback. See tests/ref_speedup.caveat.md to re-measure on your hardware.
target_hardware: cpu (x86-64 Sapphire Rapids; pure-Python stdlib -> no AVX-512 in hot path -> callgrind safe)
value_axis: retired instruction count (Ir) for a batch of block-encoded integer dot products; the naive path locates the byte for each lane one lane at a time and applies the block's scale factor once per lane rather than once per block
